column1: # manual.tsv -- HUMAN-AUTHORED. The generator never writes this file.
# Rows here are applied on top of the generated employers.tsv, keyed by
# platform+key, so a row here wins and survives every refresh. This is where a
# reviewer records:
#   * a match the generator refused because the name was ambiguous, after
#     confirming it by hand (set match_method=manual, match_confidence=high);
#   * a correction to a row the generator got wrong;
#   * a company whose facts came from a source the generator does not read.
# A row whose match_method is "refuted" DELETES the generated row instead of
# replacing it, and the source is served no employer at all. That is the
# correction for the only mistake the generator actually makes: a name
# collision, where the honest answer is not better facts about the wrong
# company but no facts about this one.
# Every row must say where its facts came from in data_sources and when they
# were retrieved. A row nobody can audit is a row nobody can fix.
# Same schema as employers.tsv.
platform
# Confirmed by hand and promoted from candidates.tsv.
# The generator refused this one because "wise" is four letters, and neither
# the ticker (WSE) nor a Wikidata website corroborated it. Checked on
# 2026-07-28: api.smartrecruiters.com/v1/companies/Wise/postings returns 398
# openings at "Worship Square, 65 Clifton Street, London EC2A 4JE", which is
# Wise's registered office, and EDGAR CIK 0002099039 is "Wise Group plc" in
# LONDON, listed on Nasdaq as WSE. Same company.
smartrecruiters
# Refuted: the generated row names a real SEC filer that is not this employer.
# Each was checked against the live board on 2026-07-28, and the evidence is
# the domain the board itself links to.
# jobs.ashbyhq.com/post is Post (post.news), a software company. CIK
# 0001530950 is Post Holdings, the St. Louis cereal maker (SIC 2040).
ashby
# authentic.breezy.hr links to authentic.org and lists paid-media and email
# strategist roles: a digital agency. CIK 0001338929 is Authentic Holdings,
# an OTC apparel wholesaler.
breezy
# giftify.breezy.hr links to giftify.me and hires a Customer Support Agent
# (FR+EN) in Brussels. CIK 0001760233 is GIFTIFY, INC. of Chicago
# (Restaurant.com, CardCash).
breezy
# CIK 0000024090 is CITIZENS, INC., an Austin life insurer (SIC 6311). The
# board is Citizens Financial Group. Carried over from the 2026-07-28 audit
# and not re-checked against the live tenant.
oraclecloud
# sinclair.teamtailor.com links to sinclair.com, the aesthetics company.
# CIK 0001971213 is Sinclair, Inc. (SBGI), the US broadcaster, whose site is
# sbgi.net.
teamtailor
# the board is titled "Job openings at waterdrop(R)", the Austrian microdrink
# brand. CIK 0001823986 is Waterdrop Inc. (WDH), a Chinese insurtech.
teamtailor
